title: Pocket Fuel Raspberry Apple Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Raspberry Apple from Pocket Fuel is a classic flavour realised to perfection, with tart, tangy raspberries on the inhale softening into fresh and juicy green apples on the exhale for a deliciously fruity taste of summer. This convenient 50ml shortfill bottle comes with 10ml of free space for the addition of a nicotine shot to tailor your vape to your liking. Its 70VG/30PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered vape mods and sub-ohm tanks .
